scope.shared_model_note: The six exact lifecycle axes are defined by foigent://schemas/connector-lifecycle/v1. This projection maps those wire values to current product-local state without adding a seventh combined state or changing current storage.

shared_document_control.product_projection: Validated before axis projection; not persisted as an M0 field.

current_values_or_rules: source_systems.status must equal active
adapter_manifests.active must equal true
source_systems.source_type must equal adapter_manifests.source_type
activation_source_instance, activation_cursor, activation_high_watermark, activated_at and authorization_ref must all be present
shared_axes_to_current_local_state.loss_or_gap: No single current configuration-state enum exists.

current_values_or_rules: authorization_ref records the durable activation authorization reference, not a secret
credentials remain outside event/provenance identity
HTTP 401 and 403 fail closed and can surface only as sanitized failure codes
shared_axes_to_current_local_state.loss_or_gap: No dedicated durable authentication status column or investigation read model exists.

current_values_or_rules: polling denotes an in-progress pull attempt
backoff denotes a retryable failure
error denotes a non-retryable failure
transport, HTTP status and response-body failures remain distinct sanitized worker error categories
shared_axes_to_current_local_state.loss_or_gap: Transport disposition is encoded by worker state plus last_error rather than a separate transport-axis column.

current_values_or_rules: legacy status values are idle, running and error
worker_status values are inactive, idle, polling, backoff, stopping and error
every item must be inserted or exact duplicate_noop before CommitPage
shared_axes_to_current_local_state.loss_or_gap: The legacy status column is overloaded; worker_status is more precise but still combines several shared axes.

current_values_or_rules: cursor advances only after every page item converges
partial-page failure leaves cursor_value unchanged
expected-cursor compare-and-set prevents a stale worker from advancing state
items_committed + duplicate_noop must equal items_received
shared_axes_to_current_local_state.loss_or_gap: The exact shared Checkpoint document exists, but current X-Insight persists its fields in adapter_import_states rather than as a standalone shared JSON document.

current_values_or_rules: idle after successful page commit
backoff after retryable failure
error after permanent failure
systemd load/active/enabled state is deployment-local and not stored in evidence events
shared_axes_to_current_local_state.loss_or_gap: No product API currently combines durable worker health with host service health.

current_transition_projection.precondition: Active source/adapter identity and no conflicting durable activation
current_transition_projection.checkpoint_effect: Initialize activation and current cursor/high-watermark to the accepted activation boundary

current_transition_projection.precondition: Expected current cursor and worker_status in inactive|idle|polling|backoff|error
worker_status=polling, expected cursor matches, and every item is committed or duplicate_noop
current_transition_projection.checkpoint_effect: Atomically advance cursor and high-watermark; reset consecutive_failures
Cursor and high-watermark unchanged; increment consecutive_failures
Cursor and high-watermark unchanged; increment consecutive_failures

checkpoint_schema_projection.product_projection: Validate exact foigent.connector-checkpoint.v1; no current durable column and no M0 field.
Validate against the portable Connector identity; retain current source_system_id and adapter_manifest_id as separate product-local registry identities.
Validate against Manifest connector_version; do not substitute current adapter_version.
Exact UTF-8 binding to adapter_import_states.activation_source_instance and to Event $.producer.instance.
Projected from activation/checkpoint state as bootstrap|steady|error; the exact shared phase is not currently stored in a dedicated column.
Operational checkpoint/status time represented by current worker timestamps; never an Event time, M0 field, hash input or item-linked provenance input.

connector_error_projection.product_projection: Current sanitized adapter_import_states.last_error, worker_status and consecutive_failures carry only the product-local durable subset. retryable=true maps to backoff; retryable=false maps to error. retry_after_seconds and recovery remain operational status values, not evidence.
connector_error_projection.privacy_and_cursor_rule: privacy and cursor remain distinct fail-closed categories; neither is collapsed into a generic record label or allowed into Event/M0 identity.

event_batch_projection.product_projection: Events are validated and normalized item by item. Batch delivery fields feed page processing and checkpoint/status only; partial-page failure leaves the checkpoint unchanged.

operational_receipt_projection.product_projection: Operation receipts map to worker/checkpoint status and counters. They are non-event-linked operational evidence and never enter normalized Event/M0 identity, hash or item-linked import provenance.

worker_service_projection.boundary: Host load/active/enabled/process state is operational product state, not an Event, M0 field, Checkpoint identity or item-linked provenance.

read_model_projection.exact_gap: Current read surfaces expose accepted evidence and data-quality state, but do not expose adapter_import_states or systemd lifecycle. B9 must preserve this fact; a future lifecycle read model is a product implementation gap, not a current compatibility behavior.

mutable_state_never_enters: item/event-linked import provenance or its identity
